operation.description:
Remove all previous custom labels and set the new custom labels for a specific
self-hosted runner configured in an organization.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the organization to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint. If the repository is private, the `repo` scope is also required.

labels.description: The names of the custom labels to set for the runner. You can pass an empty array to remove all custom labels.

operation.summary: Set custom labels for a self-hosted runner for an organization
